name: server
sql: SELECT version() AS version

name: describe_corpus
sql:
SELECT dataset,count(*) AS log_entries,
          count(ts) AS timestamped_entries,min(ts) AS first_printed_time,max(ts) AS last_printed_time,
          count(DISTINCT component) AS components,count(DISTINCT node) AS named_nodes
          FROM research_log_entries GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset

name: dictionary
sql:
CREATE TEXT SEARCH DICTIONARY research_words AS
          split_text(case := 'lower') | normalize_tokens('en_US.UTF-8', accent := false)
          WITH (frequency, position, offset, norm)

name: create_index
sql:
CREATE INDEX research_logs_idx ON research_log_entries
          USING inverted (dataset,ts,component,node,label,level,message research_words)
          INCLUDE(entry_id,source_file,request_id,instance_id,message)

name: refresh
sql: VACUUM (REFRESH_TABLE) research_log_entries

name: search_build_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s)

name: search_build_page
sql:
SELECT dataset,source_file,entry_id,ts,component,instance_id,
          ts_highlight(message,'MaxWords=24') AS snippet FROM research_logs_idx
          WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s) ORDER BY source_file,entry_id LIMIT 5

name: search_terms_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ %s

name: search_terms_page
sql:
SELECT dataset,source_file,entry_id,ts,component,node,
              ts_highlight(message,'MaxWords=24') AS snippet,BM25(research_logs_idx.tableoid) AS score
              FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ %s
              ORDER BY BM25(research_logs_idx.tableoid) DESC,source_file,entry_id LIMIT 5

name: search_phrase_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s)

name: search_phrase_page
sql:
SELECT dataset,source_file,entry_id,ts,component,node,

              ORDER BY BM25(research_logs_idx.tableoid) DESC,source_file,entry_id LIMIT 5

name: search_fuzzy_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_levenshtein(%s,1)

name: search_fuzzy_page
sql:
SELECT dataset,source_file,entry_id,ts,component,node,
              ts_highlight(message,'MaxWords=24') AS snippet,BM25(research_logs_idx.tableoid) AS score
              FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_levenshtein(%s,1)
              ORDER BY BM25(research_logs_idx.tableoid) DESC,source_file,entry_id LIMIT 5

name: search_empty_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_logs_idx WHERE message @@ %s

name: search_empty_page
sql: SELECT entry_id FROM research_logs_idx WHERE message @@ %s LIMIT 5

name: injection_bound_literal
sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_matches FROM research_log_entries WHERE component=%s

name: count_by
sql:
SELECT dataset,component,count(*) AS log_entry_count
          FROM research_log_entries GROUP BY dataset,component
          ORDER BY log_entry_count DESC,dataset,component LIMIT 20

name: trend
sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day',ts) AS bucket,count(*) AS log_entry_count
          FROM research_log_entries WHERE dataset=%s AND label<>%s
          GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

name: latency_stats_builds
sql:
SELECT source_file,count(*) AS timed_operations,
          quantile_cont(create_seconds,0.5) AS p50_s,quantile_cont(create_seconds,0.95) AS p95_s,
          quantile_cont(create_seconds,0.99) AS p99_s,max(create_seconds) AS max_s
          FROM research_log_entries WHERE dataset=%s AND create_operation=%s
          GROUP BY source_file ORDER BY source_file

name: latency_stats_http
sql:
SELECT endpoint,count(*) AS timed_requests,
          quantile_cont(latency_s,0.5) AS p50_s,quantile_cont(latency_s,0.95) AS p95_s,
          quantile_cont(latency_s,0.99) AS p99_s,max(latency_s) AS max_s
          FROM research_log_entries WHERE dataset=%s AND latency_s IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY timed_requests DESC LIMIT 20

name: compare_periods
sql:
SELECT
          count(*) FILTER(WHERE ts>=%s AND ts<%s) AS before_count,
          count(*) FILTER(WHERE ts>=%s AND ts<%s) AS after_count
          FROM research_log_entries WHERE dataset=%s AND label<>%s

name: group_entries
sql:
WITH prior AS (
          SELECT label,node,epoch_s,entry_id,
            lag(epoch_s) OVER(PARTITION BY label,node ORDER BY epoch_s,entry_id) AS previous_s
          FROM research_log_entries WHERE dataset=%s AND label<>%s), marked AS (
          SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_s IS NULL OR epoch_s-previous_s>%s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group
          FROM prior), numbered AS (
          SELECT *,sum(new_group) OVER(PARTITION BY label,node ORDER BY epoch_s,entry_id
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temporal_group FROM marked)
          SELECT label,node,temporal_group,count(*) AS log_entry_count,
          min(epoch_s) AS first_epoch_s,max(epoch_s) AS last_epoch_s
          FROM numbered GROUP BY label,node,temporal_group
          ORDER BY log_entry_count DESC,label,node,temporal_group LIMIT 10

name: create_reader
sql: CREATE ROLE research_reader LOGIN PASSWORD 'research-only-reader'

name: reader_select
sql: GRANT SELECT ON research_log_entries TO research_reader

name: create_manager
sql: CREATE ROLE research_manager LOGIN PASSWORD 'research-only-manager'

name: create_manager_view
sql:
CREATE VIEW research_manager_counts AS SELECT dataset,component,
          count(*) AS log_entry_count FROM research_log_entries GROUP BY dataset,component

name: manager_select
sql: GRANT SELECT ON research_manager_counts TO research_manager

name: reader_base_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS log_entries FROM research_log_entries

name: reader_search
sql: SELECT count(*) AS log_entries FROM research_logs_idx WHERE message @@ %s
